title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Not only have I obtained a broader understanding of leisure pursuits, but a bounty of plushies, too. Two birds with one stone, as they say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you for stepping up to the plate in my place. You took to that claw machine like a fish to water.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As it happens, I have thought of the perfect pun to commemorate your achievement.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You really clawed your way to the heights of success.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Quite the gutbuster, if I do say so myself. Well, don't hold back! Let yourself laugh!
